articles.summary: Toronto, April 7, 2026 – Highlander Silver Corp. (TSX, NYSE American: HSLV) (“Highlander Silver” or the “Company”) is pleased to provide a portfolio update following the successful completion of its combination with Bear Creek Mining (see press release dated February 26, 2026).
articles.title: Highlander Silver Provides Update; Drilling Commences at Corani Silver Project
